name: app.scss
html:
<pre class="docs-code"><code class="lang-scss">// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  app.scss — the app shell: nav bar, fullscreen menu overlay (WebGL canvas +
//  CSS moiré fallback), progress bar, view-outlet page transitions, and the
//  cookie banner. Declares the CSS cascade-layer order (base → layout →
//  components → overrides → ios-compat).
//  Layout: nav is fixed top; the menu overlay is a fixed fullscreen layer
//  above content but below dialogs (pref/lang layer above it via z-index).
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/fonts';
@import '../../base/placeholders';
@import '../../base/structure';
@import '../../base/grid-overlay';
@import 'intro-loader';

$_B_NAV: 'nav';

// ── CSS Cascade Layers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Declaring the layer ORDER here ensures the cascade priority is locked in,
// regardless of which file imports which layer first.
// Layers: base → layout → components → overrides → ios-compat
// Un-layered rules (most of this codebase) are always stronger than any layer,
// so this declaration is non-breaking — it's purely additive for future use.
@layer base, layout, components, overrides, ios-compat;

// ── App shell nav bar ─ fixed across the top; --on-dark variant inverts to light text over dark sections (contact band).
app-nav {
  display: block;
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  z-index: 1000;
  pointer-events: none;
}

[data-app-wrapper] {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  background: transparent;
}

preferences-modal:not([open]):not(.is-open),
lang-dialog:not([open]):not(.is-open) {
  display: none;
}

preferences-modal[open],
preferences-modal.is-open,
lang-dialog[open],
lang-dialog.is-open {
  display: block;
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100vw;
  height: 100vh;
  height: 100dvh;
  z-index: 10000;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

// The nav bar itself: logo + section links left/center, burger + flag + prefs triggers right.
.nav {
  @extend %MAXAREA;
  z-index: 100;
  left: 0;
  top: to-rem($space-lg);
  position: fixed;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  cursor: pointer;
  pointer-events: auto;

  &-link {
    @extend .ttl-xs;
    @extend %RESETBTN;

    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--grey-3);
    text-decoration: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition:
      opacity 0.3s ease-in,
      color 0.2s ease;
    position: relative;

    &:hover,
    &:focus {
      opacity: 0.5;
    }

    &.router-link-exact-active,
    &.active {
      color: var(--black);
      font-weight: 700;

      &::after {
        display: block;
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        bottom: -#{to-rem($space-2xs)};
        left: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: to-rem($space-2xs);
        border-radius: to-rem($space-hairline);
        background: var(--grey);
      }
    }

    &.selected-work {
      cursor: n-resize;
    }

    &.scroll-down {
      cursor: s-resize;
    }
  }

  // Logo interaction mirrors animated content links: DrawText replays its
  // word wrappers first, then this parent-owned underline sweeps in. Active
  // home state keeps the line landed, matching the other active nav links.
  &-logo-btn {
    opacity: 1;

    &::after {
      display: block;
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -#{to-rem($space-2xs)};
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: to-rem($space-2xs);
      border-radius: to-rem($space-hairline);
      background: currentColor;
      transform: scaleX(0);
      transform-origin: left center;
      transition: transform 0.35s ease 0.55s;
    }

    &:hover,
    &:focus-visible,
    &:active {
      opacity: 1;

      &::after {
        transform: scaleX(1);
      }
    }

    &.router-link-exact-active::after,
    &.active::after {
      transform: scaleX(1);
    }
  }

  // Nav over dark surfaces (contact section / page bottom) — swap ink for light greys
  &--on-dark {
    .#{$_B_NAV}-link {
      color: var(--grey-2);

      &.router-link-exact-active,
      &.active {
        color: var(--color-white-raw);
      }
    }

    .#{$_B_NAV}-separator {
      color: var(--text-muted-on-dark);
    }

    .#{$_B_NAV}-lang-btn.active {
      color: var(--color-white-raw);
    }

    .#{$_B_NAV}-burger-fallback {
      &:before,
      &:after,
      .#{$_B_NAV}-burger-line {
        background: var(--grey-2);
      }
    }
  }

  &-separator {
    @extend .ttl-xs;

    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    padding: 0 to-rem(10);
  }

  // ── Language selector pill group ─────────────────────────────────────────
  &-lang {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: to-rem(4);
  }

  &-lang-btn {
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    opacity: 0.45;
    transition:
      opacity 0.2s ease,
      color 0.2s ease;

    &:hover,
    &:focus {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    &.active {
      opacity: 1;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--black);

      &::after {
        display: block;
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        bottom: -#{to-rem($space-2xs)};
        left: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: to-rem($space-2xs);
        border-radius: to-rem($space-hairline);
        background: var(--grey);
      }
    }
  }
}

// ── Nav layout ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// A single menu for every breakpoint: logo on the left, burger on the right,
// everything else lives inside the fullscreen menu modal.

// ── Burger button (WebGL canvas) ──────────────────────────────────────────
.#{$_B_NAV}-burger-canvas {
  width: to-rem($space-2xl);
  height: to-rem($space-2xl);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: block;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);

  &.is-fallback {
    display: none;
  }
}

// ── Burger button wrapper ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
.#{$_B_NAV}-burger-wrap {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

// ── Burger button fallback (CSS-based hamburger icon) ───────────────────
.#{$_B_NAV}-burger-fallback {
  @extend %RESETBTN;

  display: none;
  width: to-rem($space-2xl);
  height: to-rem($space-2xl);
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  gap: to-rem($space-xs);
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;

  &:before,
  &:after,
  .#{$_B_NAV}-burger-line {
    content: '';
    display: block;
    width: to-rem($space-lg);
    height: to-rem($space-2xs);
    background: var(--text-primary);
    border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
  }

  // Make fallback distinct from animated version - simpler, cleaner lines
  .#{$_B_NAV}-burger-line {
    height: to-rem($space-3xs);
  }

  .#{$_B_NAV}-burger-wrap:has(.#{$_B_NAV}-burger-canvas.is-fallback) & {
    display: flex;
  }
}

// ── Burger strip (always visible) ───────────────────────────────────────────
.#{$_B_NAV}-mobile-strip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0;
}

// ── Language dialog variant (4-column option grid) ───────────────────────────
.pref-options--4 {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);

  @media (max-width: $bk-540) {
    // 540px
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}

// Language dialog shell (shared with preferences modal).
.lang-dialog {
  max-width: to-rem(480);
}

// ── Fullscreen mobile menu modal ──────────────────────────────────────────
// The modal subtree is re-created on every render, so entrance motion must
// use @keyframes (they play on insertion); exit uses the --closing modifier
// with transitions applied to the live element.
.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1000;
  background: var(--menu-bg, var(--bg-darkest, var(--bg-primary)));
  overflow: hidden;

  &--open {
    display: block;
    animation: #{$_B_NAV}-menu-in 1.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both;
  }

  &--settled {
    animation: none;
  }

  &--closing {
    animation: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.8s ease 0.1s;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
}

@keyframes #{$_B_NAV}-menu-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

// The animated menu background canvas (contour/noise field).
.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal-canvas {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  pointer-events: none;

  &.is-fallback {
    display: none;
  }
}

// ── CSS fallback membrane: turbulence isolines mimicking the shader ────────
// The WebGL field draws thin contour lines; the fallback paints the same idea
// with two ink layers clipped by SVG feTurbulence + a sparse feFuncA table —
// narrow alpha spikes at a few noise thresholds = organic isolines, not bands.
$_TURB-A: 'data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27 width=%27420%27 height=%27420%27%3E%3Cfilter id=%27f%27%3E%3CfeTurbulence type=%27fractalNoise%27 baseFrequency=%270.009 0.014%27 numOctaves=%273%27 seed=%277%27/%3E%3CfeComponentTransfer%3E%3CfeFuncA type=%27table%27 tableValues=%270 0 0 0.4 0 0.85 0 0 0.5 0 0.28 0 0 0.15 0%27/%3E%3C/feComponentTransfer%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width=%27420%27 height=%27420%27 filter=%27url%28%23f%29%27/%3E%3C/svg%3E';
$_TURB-B: 'data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27 width=%27420%27 height=%27420%27%3E%3Cfilter id=%27g%27%3E%3CfeTurbulence type=%27fractalNoise%27 baseFrequency=%270.006 0.011%27 numOctaves=%273%27 seed=%2719%27/%3E%3CfeComponentTransfer%3E%3CfeFuncA type=%27table%27 tableValues=%270 0 0.55 0 0 0.3 0 0 0.75 0 0 0.2 0%27/%3E%3C/feComponentTransfer%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width=%27420%27 height=%27420%27 filter=%27url%28%23g%29%27/%3E%3C/svg%3E';

.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal-fallback {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: none;
  pointer-events: none;
  overflow: hidden;

  &::before,
  &::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: -15%;
    background: currentColor;
  }

  &::before {
    color: var(--menu-ink, var(--text-primary));
    -webkit-mask-image: url('#{$_TURB-A}');
    mask-image: url('#{$_TURB-A}');
    -webkit-mask-size: 140% 140%;
    mask-size: 140% 140%;
    -webkit-mask-repeat: no-repeat;
    mask-repeat: no-repeat;
    animation: #{$_B_NAV}-membrane-drift 38s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }

  &::after {
    color: var(--menu-ink-2, var(--menu-ink, var(--text-primary)));
    opacity: 0.4;
    -webkit-mask-image: url('#{$_TURB-B}');
    mask-image: url('#{$_TURB-B}');
    -webkit-mask-size: 165% 165%;
    mask-size: 165% 165%;
    -webkit-mask-repeat: no-repeat;
    mask-repeat: no-repeat;
    animation: #{$_B_NAV}-membrane-drift-alt 52s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }

  animation: #{$_B_NAV}-membrane-in 2.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both;

  .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--settled & {
    opacity: 0.1;
  }

  .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--closing & {
    animation: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
  }
}

// Entrance mirrors the shader's reveal: pure opacity fade, no transform —
// the background field must stay stable while the modal animates around it.
@keyframes #{$_B_NAV}-membrane-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }

  to {
    opacity: 0.1;
  }
}

// The turbulence tile slides so the isoline field visibly breathes
@keyframes #{$_B_NAV}-membrane-drift {
  from {
    -webkit-mask-position: 0 0;
    mask-position: 0 0;
  }

  to {
    -webkit-mask-position: 14% 9%;
    mask-position: 14% 9%;
  }
}

@keyframes #{$_B_NAV}-membrane-drift-alt {
  from {
    -webkit-mask-position: 8% 12%;
    mask-position: 8% 12%;
  }

  to {
    -webkit-mask-position: -6% -4%;
    mask-position: -6% -4%;
  }
}

.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal:has(.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal-canvas.is-fallback)
  .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal-fallback,
.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--gl-fallback .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal-fallback {
  display: block;
}

// Playground routes: the fullscreen scene behind the modal is always
// dark, so pin the menu surface + inks to the dark variant regardless of
// the global theme — links, the contour shader (which samples the
// canvas's computed --menu-ink*), and the CSS fallback all stay
// white-on-dark there.
// The logo link is pinned to pure white too — --on-dark's --grey-2 reads
// as a dim grey, and on the dark playground scene the logo must read as
// full-strength white from the very first paint.
.#{$_B_NAV}--playground {
  .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal {
    --menu-bg: var(--bg-darkest);
    --menu-ink: var(--color-white-raw);
    --menu-ink-2: var(--color-white-raw);
  }

  .#{$_B_NAV}-logo-btn {
    color: var(--color-white-raw);
  }
}

// Menu overlay top row: title + circular close button.
.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal-header {
  @extend %MAXAREA;

  position: absolute;
  top: to-rem($space-lg);
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  align-items: center;
  z-index: 2;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  opacity: 0;

  .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--open & {
    animation: #{$_B_NAV}-menu-fade-up 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) 0.15s both;
  }

  .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--settled & {
    animation: none;
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }

  .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--closing & {
    animation: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
  }
}

@keyframes #{$_B_NAV}-menu-fade-up {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-#{to-rem($space-xs)});
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

// Menu item column, centered.
.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal-content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 100%;
  gap: to-rem($space-xl);
  padding: to-rem($space-2xl);
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

// Each menu entry: large thin-weight label with hover/active states; staggers in via menu-item-in.
.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal-item {
  @extend %RESETBTN;

  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: to-rem($space-md);
  padding: to-rem($space-md) to-rem($space-xl);
  width: to-rem($space-7xl);
  max-width: calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-3xl)});
  box-sizing: border-box;
  color: var(--menu-ink, var(--text-primary));
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: to-rem($space-2xs);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: transparent;
  opacity: 1;
  transition:
    letter-spacing 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    opacity 0.35s ease,
    filter 0.35s ease,
    transform 0.35s ease;

  // Hairline underline drawn on the item (the label letters' parent) — it
  // stays hidden while draw-text writes the label, then sweeps in once the
  // chars land (--draw-ms is set per item at render).
  &::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: to-rem($space-hairline);
    background: var(--menu-ink, var(--text-primary));
    opacity: 0.25;
    transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(0);
    transition:
      transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      opacity 0.3s ease;
  }

  &:hover,
  &:focus-visible,
  &:focus-within {
    letter-spacing: to-rem($space-xs);

    &::after {
      opacity: 0.75;
    }
  }

  // Pressed / pressing: the label tightens and the line gains full ink.
  &:active {
    letter-spacing: to-rem($space-2xs);
    transform: translateY(to-rem($space-hairline));

    &::after {
      opacity: 0.95;
    }
  }

  .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--open & {
    // Shell gets a quick settle-in fade; the label's letters provide the
    // real entrance via draw-text, so no blur/translate double-animation.
    animation: #{$_B_NAV}-menu-item-in 0.45s ease both;

    &::after {
      transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(1);
      transition-delay: var(--draw-ms, 0.6s);
    }
  }

  .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--settled & {
    animation: none;

    &::after {
      transition: none;
    }
  }

  .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--closing & {
    animation: none;
    opacity: 0;
    filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    transform: translateY(-#{to-rem($space-sm)});
    transition:
      letter-spacing 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      opacity 0.55s ease,
      filter 0.55s ease,
      transform 0.55s ease;

    &::after {
      transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(0);
      transition-delay: 0s;
    }
  }

  // Current section: hairline fully visible, no letter-spacing jump
  &--active::after {
    opacity: 0.75;
  }

  // Flag inside the language item: height-driven, natural aspect ratio
  .flag-canvas,
  .flag-img {
    height: to-rem($space-lg);
    width: auto;
    border-radius: to-rem($space-3xs);
  }

  .flag-split {
    display: inline-flex;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: to-rem($space-3xs);
  }

  .#{$_B_NAV}-flag-wrapper:has(.flag-canvas:not(.is-fallback)) {
    .flag-img,
    .flag-split {
      display: none;
    }
  }

  // The flag lands WITH the label — hidden while draw-text writes the
  // letters, then fades in on the same --draw-ms tick the underline
  // sweeps in on (instead of popping ahead of the drawn type).
  .#{$_B_NAV}-flag-wrapper {
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.4s ease;

    .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--open & {
      opacity: 1;
      transition-delay: var(--draw-ms, 0.6s);
    }

    .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--settled & {
      transition-delay: 0s;
    }

    .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--closing & {
      transition-delay: 0s;
    }
  }
}

@keyframes #{$_B_NAV}-menu-item-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

// WebGL close button — positioned inside modal header at exact same place & size as burger
.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal .pref-close-btn {
  @extend %RESETBTN;

  position: relative;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: to-rem($space-2xl);
  height: to-rem($space-2xl);
  border-radius: var(--radius-round);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  background: var(--border-color);
  overflow: hidden;
  z-index: 2;
  transition:
    background 0.2s ease,
    transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal .pref-close-canvas {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: var(--radius-round);
  display: block;
  pointer-events: none;

  &.is-fallback {
    display: none;
  }
}

// Fallback close button icon when WebGL fails
.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal:has(.pref-close-canvas.is-fallback) .pref-close-btn {
  position: relative;

  &::before,
  &::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 50% auto auto 50%;
    translate: -50% -50%;
    width: to-rem($space-md);
    height: to-rem($space-2xs);
    background: var(--text-primary);
    border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
  }

  &::before {
    rotate: 45deg;
  }

  &::after {
    rotate: -45deg;
  }
}

// When modal is open, the nav shows these instead of page links.
.modal-nav-title {
  @extend .ttl-xs;

  font-weight: 200;
  color: var(--menu-ink, var(--text-primary));
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: to-rem(2);
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  overflow: hidden;
  white-space: nowrap;
  max-width: 60%;
  opacity: 0.7;
}

// Close trigger inside the menu overlay.
.modal-nav-close {
  @extend %RESETBTN;
  @extend .ttl-xs;

  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--menu-ink, var(--text-primary));
  cursor: pointer;
  position: relative;
  padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-md);
  transition: color 0.2s ease;

  &::before,
  &::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: to-rem($space-md);
    height: to-rem($space-md);
    transition:
      width 0.2s ease,
      height 0.2s ease;
  }

  &::before {
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    border-top: 1px solid currentColor;
    border-left: 1px solid currentColor;
  }

  &::after {
    bottom: 0;
    right: 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor;
    border-right: 1px solid currentColor;
  }

  &:hover,
  &:focus-visible {
    color: var(--white);

    &::before,
    &::after {
      width: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
      height: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
    }
  }
}

// Cookie consent banner: fixed bottom bar.
.cookies {
  @extend %MAXAREA;

  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 300;

  position: fixed;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  z-index: var(--z-cookies);

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: to-rem($space-md);
  flex-wrap: wrap;

  padding-top: to-rem($space-md);
  padding-bottom: to-rem($space-md);
  background: rgba($color-black, 0.94);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(#{to-rem($space-lg)});
  backdrop-filter: blur(#{to-rem($space-lg)});
  border-top: to-rem($space-hairline) solid rgba($color-white, 0.15);
  color: var(--color-white-raw); // Banner bg is always dark — raw white text token
  font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
  line-height: 1.5;
  box-shadow: 0 -#{to-rem($space-2xs)} to-rem($space-xl) rgba($color-black, 0.2);

  // Mobile: no backdrop-filter — extremely expensive on mobile GPUs.
  // Solid background looks identical and costs nothing.
  @media (max-width: $bk-768) {
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
    backdrop-filter: none;
    background: rgba($color-black, 0.98);
  }

  @include layout-768() {
    padding-top: to-rem($space-lg);
    padding-bottom: to-rem($space-lg);
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
  }

  &-info {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: to-rem(260);
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
    opacity: 0.9;
    font-weight: 300;

    a {
      @extend %LK_LINK;

      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
      opacity: 0.8;
      transition:
        opacity 0.2s ease,
        border-bottom-color 0.3s ease;

      &:hover,
      &:focus-visible {
        opacity: 1;
      }
    }
  }

  &-buttons {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: to-rem($space-sm);
    flex-shrink: 0;

    &-accept,
    &-refuse {
      @extend %RESETBTN;
      @extend .ttl-xs;

      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: to-rem($space-pixel);
      cursor: pointer;
      position: relative;
      padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-lg);
      color: rgba($color-white, 0.7); // Always light on always-dark banner bg
      background: transparent;
      transition:
        color 0.2s ease,
        background 0.2s ease;
      white-space: nowrap;

      // Animated corner borders
      &::before,
      &::after {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        width: to-rem($space-xs);
        height: to-rem($space-xs);
        transition:
          width 0.2s ease,
          height 0.2s ease;
      }

      &::before {
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        border-top: to-rem($space-hairline) solid currentColor;
        border-left: to-rem($space-hairline) solid currentColor;
      }

      &::after {
        bottom: 0;
        right: 0;
        border-bottom: to-rem($space-hairline) solid currentColor;
        border-right: to-rem($space-hairline) solid currentColor;
      }

      &:hover,
      &:focus {
        color: $color-white;

        &::before,
        &::after {
          width: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-2xs)});
          height: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-2xs)});
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

.fade-enter,
.fade-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
}

// ── Skeleton shimmer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Uses project palette greys, lighter tones, subtler animation.
@keyframes skeleton-shimmer {
  0% {
    transform: translateX(-100%);
  }
  100% {
    transform: translateX(100%);
  }
}

// Skeleton placeholder shimmer surface (the base visual — animation is the skeleton-shimmer keyframes).
.skeleton {
  display: inline-block;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--skel-bg-1);
  border-radius: to-rem($space-xs);

  &::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, var(--skel-bg-2) 50%, transparent 100%);
    transform: translateX(-100%);
    animation: skeleton-shimmer 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
    will-change: transform;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  &--block {
    display: block;
  }
  &--round {
    border-radius: 50%;
  }

  // Image-placeholder skeleton: fill the render-placeholder SVG slot
  &--media {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 0;
  }
}

@keyframes slide-in {
  from {
    transform: translate3d(200%, 0, 0);
    opacity: 0;
  }
  to {
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

@keyframes slide-out {
  from {
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    opacity: 1;
  }
  to {
    transform: translate3d(200%, 0, 0);
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

@keyframes slide-in-bottom {
  from {
    transform: translate3d(0, 100%, 0);
  }
  to {
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  }
}

@keyframes slide-out-bottom {
  from {
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  }
  to {
    transform: translate3d(0, 100%, 0);
  }
}

@keyframes dash {
  to {
    stroke-dashoffset: 10;
  }
}

// ── Progress bar ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.progress-bar {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: to-rem(2);
  width: 100%;
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: left;
  background: var(--grey);
  z-index: 9999;
  transition:
    transform 0.1s ease,
    opacity 0.3s ease;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;

  &--active {
    transform: scaleX(0.7);
    opacity: 1;
    transition: transform 8s cubic-bezier(0.04, 0.6, 0.2, 1);
  }

  // Route finished: sweep to 100% quickly, then fade out in place — the
  // later class removal snaps scaleX back to 0 while opacity is already
  // 0, so the bar never visibly retracts (nprogress-style completion).
  &--done {
    transform: scaleX(1);
    opacity: 0;
    transition:
      transform 0.3s ease-out,
      opacity 0.4s ease 0.3s;
  }
}

// ── Page transitions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// All use mode="out-in" in App.vue

// Fade
.fade-enter-active,
.fade-leave-active {
  transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
}
.fade-enter-from,
.fade-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
}

// Slide left: new page enters from right
.slide-left-enter-active {
  transition:
    opacity 0.3s ease,
    transform 0.3s ease;
}
.slide-left-leave-active {
  transition:
    opacity 0.25s ease,
    transform 0.25s ease;
}
.slide-left-enter-from {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(to-rem(48));
}
.slide-left-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(to-rem(-32));
}

// Slide right: new page enters from left
.slide-right-enter-active {
  transition:
    opacity 0.3s ease,
    transform 0.3s ease;
}
.slide-right-leave-active {
  transition:
    opacity 0.25s ease,
    transform 0.25s ease;
}
.slide-right-enter-from {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(to-rem(-48));
}
.slide-right-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(to-rem(32));
}

// Slide up: new page enters from bottom
.slide-up-enter-active {
  transition:
    opacity 0.35s ease,
    transform 0.35s ease;
}
.slide-up-leave-active {
  transition:
    opacity 0.25s ease,
    transform 0.25s ease;
}
.slide-up-enter-from {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(to-rem(48));
}
.slide-up-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(to-rem(-24));
}

// Slide down: when leaving About/Legal
.slide-down-enter-active {
  transition:
    opacity 0.3s ease,
    transform 0.3s ease;
}
.slide-down-leave-active {
  transition:
    opacity 0.25s ease,
    transform 0.25s ease;
}
.slide-down-enter-from {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(to-rem(-32));
}
.slide-down-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(to-rem(32));
}

// ── Global Reduced Motion Override ─────────────────────────────────────────
html.reduced-motion,
html.reduced-motion *,
html.reduced-motion *::before,
html.reduced-motion *::after {
  animation-duration: 0.001ms;
  animation-iteration-count: 1;
  transition-duration: 0.001ms;
  transition-delay: 0.001ms;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.001ms;
    animation-iteration-count: 1;
    transition-duration: 0.001ms;
    transition-delay: 0.001ms;
  }
}

// ── 3D Book Page Flip Transition ──────────────────────────────────────────────
// ── Page cross-fade transition ───────────────────────────────────────────────
// Outgoing view fades to opacity 0 (350ms), then incoming view fades in.
// Driven by JS in App._flipToView(); no direction logic needed.
#view-outlet > * {
  transition: opacity 0.35s ease;
}

.page-fade-out {
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

// Incoming view starts invisible; JS removes this class after a reflow
// so the CSS transition drives the fade-in automatically.
.page-fade-in {
  opacity: 0;
}

// ── Nav flag images & WebGL Canvas ────────────────────────────────────────────
.#{$_B_NAV}-lang-open-btn {
  display: inline-flex;

  transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);

.#{$_B_NAV}-flag-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  &:has(.#{$_B_FLAG}-canvas:not(.is-fallback):not([style*='display: none'])) {
    .#{$_B_FLAG}-img,

      display: none;

  // Show SVG images when WebGL canvas has fallback
  &:has(.#{$_B_FLAG}-canvas.is-fallback) {
    .#{$_B_FLAG}-img,
    .#{$_B_FLAG}-split {
      display: block;
    }
  }

  .#{$_B_FLAG}-canvas {
    height: to-rem($space-lg);
    width: auto;
    display: block;
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
  }
}

.#{$_B_FLAG}-img {
  height: to-rem($space-lg);
  width: auto;
  max-height: to-rem($space-lg);
  display: block;
  border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
}

// Split flag: two country codes side by side
.#{$_B_FLAG}-split {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;

  .#{$_B_FLAG}-img {
    height: to-rem($space-lg);
    width: to-rem($space-md);
    max-height: to-rem($space-lg);
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: 0;

    &:first-child {
      border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs) 0 0 to-rem($space-2xs);
      object-position: left center;
    }

    &:last-child {
      border-radius: 0 to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-2xs) 0;
      object-position: right center;
    }
  }
}
